description:
The farmOS Field Kit app is open on the Tasks screen showing 'Let's Get Started!'. Your task:
1. Tap the green '+' button at the bottom right to create a new log.
2. In the 'Edit Log' form, enter 'Pest check - aphids on tomatoes' as the Name.
3. The Log Type defaults to 'Activity'. Tap the Log Type dropdown and change it to 'Observation'.
4. In the Notes field, enter 'Found aphids on 3 tomato plants in row 5. Will need treatment.'.
5. Toggle the 'Done' switch to OFF (unchecked) to mark this as an incomplete task.
6. Tap the back arrow to save and return to the Tasks list.
7. Verify the new Observation log appears in the Tasks list.
